propositions: add_comment returns raw batch mutation envelope (results/totalCount/successCount) instead of normalized comment resource, causing callers to misinterpret WORK_ITEM keys as comment IDs
normalization helper _parse_comment_created unpacks batch envelope to {id: None, acli_envelope: ...}, passes through resource-shaped dicts unchanged, and raises RuntimeError on unrecognized shapes

other --json mutation wrappers (create_issue, get_issue, get_comments) already normalize or verify payloads at transport boundary; acli.update_issue retains raw passthrough but poses no consumer-reachable hazard today
recorded real ACLI 1.3.19 failure envelope (acli jira workitem comment create --key NONEXIST-999999) captured and committed as constant with provenance note for edge-case testing

silent no-op in _record_comment_id during bug irongrey-chubby-oxpecker allowed 205 comments/hour re-post until 5000-comment cap, mitigated by tolerant recording but root cause (envelope shape mismatch) unfixed until this change
